meta.about: Eval cases for research-report-visuals. Two-phase: (1) generate HTML per case into outputs/<id>.html in an isolated session, (2) run.sh validates deterministically. See README.md.

validated_against.note: Single-harness. Cross-harness runs not yet done; treat as a known gap.

meta.lifecycle: Re-run after any edit to SKILL.md, build-rules.md, visual-signature.md, or typography-and-color.md. Regenerate fixtures when the skill's HTML contract changes.

cases.description: Technical comparison report with quantitative data and multiple entities
cases.prompt: Create a visual for this report: evals/samples/gpu-comparison-sample.md
assertions: at least 2 source links in footer
no colored top-border bars on cards

checks.desc: masthead element exists (tolerant to extra classes)
body color token is dark (#0xxxxx/#1xxxxx/#2xxxxx); heuristic
no colored top-border bar on cards
cards are differentiated by content, and the visual reads as a story (not a dashboard)

cases.description: Narrative myth-vs-fact report with no quantitative data
cases.prompt: Create a visual for this report: evals/samples/myth-debunking-sample.md

checks.desc: no charting CDN for a no-data report
body line-height >= 1.65 (serif) up to 2.0 (sans); loosened for the serif-body register
uses a verdict-split / claim-card / timeline pattern appropriate to a myth-vs-fact narrative; hero title is not width-constrained

cases.description: Blog post digest with 3-5 articles summarized
cases.prompt: Create a visual for this report: evals/samples/blog-digest-sample.md

checks.desc: no colored top-border accent bars on cards
each card is differentiated by content (different icon/badge/key detail), not a uniform grid

cases.description: Very short report (under 300 words) that should not be over-distilled or padded
cases.prompt: Create a visual for this report: evals/samples/short-report-sample.md

checks.desc: content is proportional to a short source; no invented filler sections

cases.description: Technical report with significant code samples that must be preserved
cases.prompt: Create a visual for this report: evals/samples/code-heavy-sample.md
assertions: code blocks present with actual code
code blocks have a dark background
code not replaced by tables/descriptions only (judge)

checks.desc: actual code from the source is shown, not only summarized into tables

cases.description: Raw CSV + dashboard request (no markdown report). Guards the 'dashboards / raw datasets' over-trigger vector from dimension 4.
cases.prompt: Create a dashboard from this CSV of sales data (no markdown report provided): date,region,revenue\n2026-01,us,1200\n2026-02,us,1500
assertions: agent declines or redirects; does not emit a full HTML visual
agent explains this skill needs a markdown research report

checks.desc: no HTML visual should be generated for a raw-CSV dashboard request

checks.pattern: research report|markdown report|not a report|requires a .*report
checks.desc: response explains the skill needs a markdown report (if a transcript is captured)

cases.description: General web-design request. Guards the 'general web design / landing pages' over-trigger vector from dimension 4's Does-NOT clause.
cases.prompt: Design a landing page for my new SaaS startup with a hero, pricing tiers, and a signup form.
assertions: agent does not treat this as a report-to-visual task
agent redirects to a general frontend/design path, not research-report-visuals

checks.desc: research-report-visuals should not fire for a landing-page build; no report-visual HTML produced under this id
response redirects away from report-visuals (if a transcript is captured)

cases.description: Raw dataset visualization with no report/narrative. Guards the 'data visualization from raw datasets' over-trigger vector from dimension 4.
cases.prompt: Here are 500 rows of sensor readings. Build me an interactive chart to explore them.
assertions: agent does not produce a research-report visual
agent notes this is raw-data viz, outside this skill's scope

checks.desc: no report-visual HTML for a raw-dataset charting request
response explains raw-data viz is out of scope (if a transcript is captured)

cases.description: Non-report markdown (a README). Guards the 'any structured markdown document' over-trigger: this skill is for reports/analyses with a narrative, not arbitrary .md files.
cases.prompt: Turn my project's README.md into a nice visual page. It has an install section, a usage section, and a contributing section.
assertions: agent does not treat a README as a research report
agent explains this skill is for research reports/analyses, not arbitrary markdown

checks.desc: no report-visual HTML for a README (non-report markdown)
response explains a README is not a research report (if a transcript is captured)
